## Description

Members now shows the trusted workspace name beside ordinary Connect/Members/Audit navigation, with a 32px title, visible focus and full-width content. Audit keeps its form, optional script and Save/Test behavior. This implements UI-01 of the approved Refined tabs plan; later invitation and pending changes belong to the stacked children.

The source candidate remains `37046bbd` on main `9507e751`. Source, tests, quality findings and declarations are unchanged from published v1. The required local Linux AMD64 image gate now passes at this exact head, including the complete offline build and seven runtime cases. No assertion or deadline changed; earlier failed image attempts remain historical.
